content.text: ▪︎GI (diarrhea), antimuscarinic effects (⇡ HR), ⇡ mortality in AFIB/flutter (control AV conduction before initiating)
(tinnitus, vision/hearing loss, HA, delirium), alpha blockade (hypotension)
proarrhythmic effects in AFIB & ventricular arrhythmias
avoid use in pheochromocytoma or cocaine use
(not associated w/ ⇡ mortality risk), contraindicated in iodine allergies, ⇣ digoxin dose by 50%
be used w/ LV systolic dysfunction (HFrEF) or decompensated HF d/t ⊖inotropic effects
▪︎Warnings: sinus bradycardia, AV nodal block, hypotension, HF, ⇡ LFTs
, chest pain/pressure, dizziness, transient hypotension, dizziness
: N/V, visual changes (halos, yellow or blurred vision), lethargy, life-threatening arrhythmias
▪︎⇣ dose by 50% when used w/ amiodarone, narrow TI (monitoring required)
